name: Item Report
query:
SELECT
  `Code` AS "Item Code:Data:100",
  name AS "Brand Name:Data:280",
  item_name AS "Description:Data:350",
  
  valuation_rate AS "Cost:Data:80",
  standard_rate AS "Price:Data:80",
  last_purchase_rate AS "Last Purchase Rate:Data:120"
FROM tabItem
WHERE disabled = 0;
